behavior.arguments: rdi = first argument, rsi = second argument; all comparisons unsigned

branches.else_path: neither gate holds: jump through slot B to 0x54c2670
branches.first_gate_path: rsi < 0x11 and rsi <= rdi: jump through slot A to 0x54c06b0
branches.tzcnt_gate_path: tzcnt(rsi) == 0 (rsi odd): jump through slot A to 0x54c06b0

edges.order_fail: (rdi, rsi) = (15, 16) -> B; 16 <= 15 is false and tzcnt(16) = 4
edges.zero: (rdi, rsi) = (0, 0) -> A via the first gate; rsi = 0 never reaches the tzcnt branch

behavior.formula: dispatch(rdi, rsi) = A if (rsi < 0x11 and rsi <= rdi) or tzcnt(rsi) == 0, else B; tzcnt(0) = 64
behavior.output_shape: no return value in the window itself: both paths are tail jumps through GOT slots; the slot targets' contracts are not claimed

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, no runtime rebase

incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_slots_note: one R_X86_64_RELATIVE record in .rela.dyn names this window as addend, at GOT slot 0x576fd50; the file stores 0 there, applied only at load time; the two dispatch slots (0x576dfd8, 0x576e290) are recorded under behavior.dispatch_slots, not here
